title: C3 #15204 stage 8: S8-T #22962 + S8 retire the four catalog row objects; both Tier H; land right after D #22900 (handed to the engine lane)
body:
Part of #15204

**Handed out of the #15194 epic subtree to the `domain:engine` lane.** The maintainer asked the epic PM (`session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR`, `marchtian`) to hand development to the lanes and keep to project management (「哪些开发可以派给车道经理？你尽量只做项目管理」, 2026-10-12). This lane already holds the work that follows stage 8: 7a ∥ 7b → 8-post (#22975), and C7b (#22937 / #15211). This card is the lane's claim surface. The maintainer's tasks are `priority:p1`.

## Where this sits
- **Landing order** (#15204, seat answer 6119027520): T1 #22897 → T2 #22898 → D #22900 → **S8-T #22962 → S8** → 7a ∥ 7b → 8-post → C7b.
- **Gate:** D #22900 is on `main`. D is Tier H and waits on the maintainer's approval; the epic seat lands T1 → T2 → D back to back. The epic seat flips this card from `pm:blocked` to `pm:queue` when D merges.
- **The build so far** (by `session_01MGoWgeE8rhsrig77V4oUZn`, now parked; the lane takes over from here):
  - **S8-T** is draft PR #22962 on `claude/issue-15204-s8t-tests` @ `813dfed93e`. It is the test half: suites stop depending on `sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set` and `sys_capability`. It is `dirty` against `main` today.
  - **S8** has no PR yet. It is branch `claude/issue-15204-s8-catalog-objects` @ `dbae752f6e` (`main` + D `fcaedfdaa1` + one commit). It unregisters the four objects and unwires the projector, both write-throughs and the position backfill (E1).
  - Read first: the stage-8 report 6118994290 (its `d_merge_recipe_for_s8t`, and the carriers it names for 7a/7b and 8-post), the stage-8 tier record 6110777865 and the rulings it cites, and the seat amendment 6116546399.

## The work
1. **When D is on `main`**, merge `main` into S8-T #22962. D has changed since `fcaedfdaa1`: it now carries the uninstall cleanup that revokes grants by catalog set name. So also re-check the cases the report pinned against D. Use the repo's regen tooling; no rebase, no force. Then land S8-T.
2. **Open S8 from `main`** once S8-T has merged: re-merge the S8 branch onto current `main`, open a draft PR, and land it right after S8-T.
3. **Both are Tier H** by size (S8-T is about 5.1k changed lines; S8 is above 3,000), so each needs the maintainer's approval or merge, with the ACCEPT, `needs-user-decision` and 维护者速读 kit. Neither touches a governed surface.
4. **Each PR:**
   - a `Clause-②` line per `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`;
   - `Part of #15204`, with no closing keyword;
   - a full contract review;
   - the dogfood run locally: under #22998, PR and queue CI no longer run the dogfood shards, so `main`'s full battery is their first CI record;
   - `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` with no model name (`check:commit-card-trailers` refuses a model-named trailer);
   - no `CHANGELOG.md`, no `content/docs/releases/`.
5. **After S8 lands:** post "S8 on `main`" on #22975, #22976 and #22978, which wait on it.

## Out of scope
D, T1 and T2 stay with the epic seat. The console pin (`.objectui-sha`) is claimed by the epic seat for pin hop #3 until it lands.
